items.excerpt: Foundry has released SmartRoto, an AI-assisted rotoscoping plugin for Nuke that accelerates the keyframing grind while keeping the artist in control of shape creation. 'This isn't the magic bullet... it's about accelerating the keyframing process,' says Foundry's Adam Cherbetji.

NVIDIA research leaders will deliver a 'Next Era of Graphics — Neural Rendering, World Models, and Simulation' keynote at SIGGRAPH 2026, spotlighting neural-rendering techniques (including DLSS-style real-time final pixels) and world models reshaping how VFX and animation pipelines generate imagery.
